title: When strategy moves
sub: The map before the data, a series on enterprise architecture and why it matters for data: one change in strategy, a social tariff for every eligible household, walked down every layer of the map to the owners who must agree; checked against the principles before it's designed; asking another organisation for the least; new rules with homes; the households an automatic route would miss; a data product's contract versioned, its readers found through lineage; and the path in plateaus, answered in a day.
howto: Paper on a wall is a draft or a request; glass in the layers' colours is the confirmed model. Purple is motivation, where goals live; amber is strategy, where capabilities live; yellow is the business layer; peach is information; blue is what runs it. Gold tags name owners. The network's side of the wall is blue, retail's is rose.
